partial_lessons.note: The unit drills the look; the 25-chart gallery itself is a Model Book data job.
PDT and settlement are taught in F9; the Method unit drills only how the doctrine consumes day trades.
Order types are taught in F10; the Method unit drills only the buy-stop workflow and slippage in R.
The self-diagnostic is personal; the unit drills the three families, not the member's own map.
The playbook is authored in the Notebook; Study rehearses the plan, it does not store the playbook.
The defense is graded by the owner outside Study; the unit rehearses the rubric.
